description: This file defines a service class 'EzLearningUserDetailsService' that implements the 'UserDetailsService' interface for integrating custom user data retrieval with Spring Security. It loads user details based on username, using repositories to fetch user and group information, and constructs a UserPrincipal object.

classes.name: EzLearningUserDetailsService
classes.description: Service class implementing 'UserDetailsService' to load user-specific data during authentication.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details and authorities based on username, throwing exception if user not found.
